question: What term describes a resting pulse rate below sixty beats per minute in an adult?

options.B: Bradycardia
options.C: Tachycardia
options.D: Asystole

explanation: Bradycardia is the medical term for a slower-than-normal heart rate, defined as falling below sixty beats per minute in adult humans. [learn more](GNS111_U2_T8#GNS111_U2_T8_h6)

question: Why is viewing a community as a social system beneficial for nursing professionals?

options.A: It eliminates the need for individual patient assessments
options.B: It simplifies the legal definitions of local government areas
options.C: It dictates the precise budget needed for primary health centers
options.D: It helps identify how collective behaviors and networks influence health

explanation: Understanding community networks reveals the underlying social structures that shape health habits and disease patterns. [learn more](GNS225_U1_T4#GNS225_U1_T4_h1)

question: What is the primary purpose of conducting a Root Cause Analysis after a sentinel event?

options.A: To assign immediate personal blame to the nurse on duty
options.B: To satisfy legal requirements for malpractice lawsuits
options.C: To uncover the fundamental system reasons why the failure occurred
options.D: To calculate the financial cost of destroyed equipment

explanation: Root Cause Analysis looks past surface errors to identify deep systemic flaws that allowed the incident to happen. [learn more](GST319_U5_T6#GST319_U5_T6_h5)
